Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–1918
1 How important was the First Battle of Ypres as a cause of trench warfare? Explain your answer.
How significant was declining support for the war as a reason for Germany’s surrender in 1918?
Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–1945
How important was the 25-Point Programme in the development of the Nazi Party to 1934? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant was Himmler in establishing the Nazi dictatorship? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–1941
How important was the Kornilov Affair as a reason for Bolshevik success in November 1917?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was control of the media in maintaining Stalin’s dictatorship? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY D: THE USA, 1919–1941
How important were the problems of older industries in the US economy of the 1920s? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant was the fear of communism as a factor shaping the nature of US society in the
1920s? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important was the redistribution of land in changing life in China in the 1950s and 1960s?
Explain your answer.
How significant was repression in maintaining Communist rule in China? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important was the ANC in the opposition to apartheid? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were the actions of Vorster to the maintenance of white minority rule from 1961?
Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was the Partition Plan as a cause of the 1948-49 War? Explain your answer.
How significant a role did the United Nations play in the Arab-Israeli conflict after 1973? Explain
your answer.
